versions.changelog: Add git to required bins, add security notice for config.json secrets and unauthenticated dashboard, add priceSpikeEnabled/volumeSpikeEnabled config docs

Buzz v1.1.0 expands real-time news aggregation features and configuration options:

- Adds detailed REST API documentation covering setup, authentication, and endpoints for managing sources, KOLs, and notifications.
- Supports real-time push notifications to Discord and Telegram.
- New API endpoints to manage Jin10, BlockBeats, RSS, X KOLs, Polymarket, and OpenNews sources.
- Enhanced configuration via hot-reload REST API—no server restarts required.
- Health check and live server-sent events (SSE) endpoints for monitoring and live feeds.
- Configuration schema documentation for all supported news sources and push services.
